Chapter 6770: Qiuniu Cauldron

Chapter 6770: Qiuniu Cauldron

Spectators dared not breathe loudly while others trembled, speechless.

Tiger Ancestor met his demise while Dragon Ancestor became a maid. Both suffered immediate defeat.

Xiaoyue’s power exceeded their imagination and sense of logic. After all, ancient ancestors whom they deemed unbeatable were so beatable. The imperial realm was distant enough. What about the immortal realm?

What was the point in becoming an emperor? They would just be slightly stronger insects.

“I will show mercy as long as Sky Zenith hands over the divine artifact.” Li Qiye waved.

Dragon Ancestor lamented her pride early on. She understood that the immortal had decided to give them a chance by allowing Phoenix Emperor to act as a messenger.

He or his maid could have wiped them out and taken the divine artifact. Were their artifacts even valuable in the immortals’ eyes?

“I obey.” Phoenix Emperor understood the command.

“Brother Yudi, please come with Qiuniu Cauldron before obliteration!” His words echoed across the realms and reached Sky Zenith.

This was not an imperious act; he merely preferred the destruction of just Sky Zenith instead of all of Beastmaster World. It was in everyone’s interest to finish this matter as fast as possible.

“Boom!” A blue light erupted across Beastmaster, changing the color of everything. All living beings became suppressed and vulnerable.

“Sky Zenith is furious, why?” Many didn’t know what was going on in Azure Plain.

This was the strongest lineage in Beastmaster and it hadn’t shown this much anger before.

“Phoenix Emperor, you are too arrogant!” Someone roared.

A figure leaped into the sky and released his aura, killing many cultivators along the way.

“Ahh!” The unlucky souls exploded into blood.

This person was none other than the strongest ancestor in Beastmaster - Yudi.

“Yudi!” His lack of control, resulting in countless deaths, infuriated the crowd. Alas, they couldn’t do anything to him.

He was rather short in stature and didn’t look like the strongest cultivator in Beastmaster. However, his rampant aura told a different tale. He became majestic like the eye of the storm, always ready to tear the world apart.

“Brother, I am saying this out of goodwill, please hand the cauldron over.” Phoenix Emperor shook his head.

“It’s right here, come get it if you can.” A cauldron appeared above Yudi’s head.

It was as white as jade with runic lines resembling cracks. Overall, it appeared as if it was refined from a skull. It pulsed brightly, seemingly capable of devouring Beastmaster and refining it entirely.

“The legendary cauldron...” A spectator said. Rumor has it this was the greatest among the three, far more potent than its peers. This was because it was refined from the skull.

“Your insistence will result in the end of your sect. To avoid this, please just hand the cauldron over.” Phoenix Emperor shook his head.

Yudi paused for a second before bursting out in laughter: “Phoenix Emperor, although you are a genius worthy of your fame, you are overestimating yourself in my presence.”
